analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: We may anonymize, pseudonymize, aggregate and de-identify the data that we collect and use this data for our own internal business purposes, including sharing it with our business partners, our affiliated businesses, agents and other third parties for commercial, statistical and market research purposes.

analysis.headline: Shares for Advertising & Analytics
analysis.quote: We display advertising on the Website and may use remarketing and tracking features. We may use the following services for advertising, remarketing, and tracking purposes: Google Ad Manager and Google Ads, Meta pixel, X (formerly Twitter) Conversion Tracking (X Pixel).

analysis.headline: Retains Your Deleted Public Content
analysis.quote: Some data, such as published ideas/scripts and messages sent to other users, will be saved as they have already integrated into our system. This data must be stored to maintain the integrity of the platform.

analysis.headline: Retains Data for 10 Years
analysis.quote: For legitimate business processes and for compliance with legal obligations, including tax laws, audits, and security, we must retain certain data for an extended period. This data includes, but is not limited to, transaction logs, financial records, addresses, and employment details. The duration of retention for each type of data will comply with specific legal requirements, extending up to 10 years.

analysis.headline: No Opt-Out for Service Emails
analysis.quote: Paid Users will also receive a notification email from our payment processor if there are any issues regarding billing their cards for auto-renew subscriptions. Users cannot opt out of these messages, though they can delete their account.

analysis.headline: Collects Detailed Device Analytics
analysis.quote: This information may include your general device information, device identifiers (for example, Google Advertising ID, if you are using an Android device, or Advertising Identifier (IDFA), if you are using an iOS device), network information, website, and application interaction events.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Globally
analysis.quote: The information collected through Services will be stored on servers located in the United States, European Union, and other destinations (including outside the EEA), to our service providers and affiliated businesses for the purposes described above. Note that the countries concerned may not provide the same legal standards for protection of your personal data that you have in the EEA.

analysis.headline: Google reCAPTCHA Tracks Your Behavior
analysis.quote: reCAPTCHA analyses the behavior of the visitor using various characteristics and evaluates various information for analysis purposes (e.g. IP address, visit duration, or the user's mouse clicks). This analysis begins automatically, as soon as the website visitor accesses the website, and runs in the background. Visitors are not informed that an analysis is being performed. The data recorded during analysis is forwarded to Google.

analysis.headline: Recipients Keep Your Messages
analysis.quote: When you use private messages to communicate, please keep in mind that the recipients have a copy of your correspondence as well. This will continue to be the case even if you delete such correspondence from your account. Recipients can copy, store and/or reshare these messages. Be constantly vigilant of this.

analysis.headline: No Control Over Linked Sites
analysis.quote: At our discretion we may add links (web links) to other websites from our Website. These websites can be run by third parties with separate and independent privacy policies. We, therefore, have no responsibility nor are we liable for any content, activities or privacy policies of these linked sites.
